ko.title: $103,265라는 가격표: 트럼프의 H-1B 비자 수수료 영구화 추진 내막

segments.src: ## A Fee That Refuses to Go Away
segments.tr: ## 사라지기를 거부하는 수수료

segments.src: A six-figure charge on H-1B visa petitions is back in the spotlight.
segments.tr: H-1B 비자 청원에 부과되는 6자리 수의 수수료가 다시 주목받고 있습니다.

segments.src: After a federal judge blocked the Trump administration's attempt to impose a $103,265 fee on new H-1B applications, officials responded this week by publishing a formal rule aimed at putting the same price tag into law through the standard regulatory process.
segments.tr: 연방 판사가 신규 H-1B 신청에 $103,265의 수수료를 부과하려는 트럼프 행정부의 시도를 막아선 후, 당국자들은 이번 주 정식 규정 제정 절차를 통해 동일한 가격표를 법제화하는 것을 목표로 하는 공식 규정을 발표하며 대응했습니다.

segments.src: The move opens a 30-day public comment period, giving businesses, workers, universities and advocacy groups a chance to weigh in before the rule can be finalized.
segments.tr: 이 조치로 30일간의 공공 의견 수렴 기간이 시작되어, 규정이 최종 확정되기 전에 기업, 근로자, 대학 및 옹호 단체가 의견을 제시할 수 있는 기회가 제공됩니다.

segments.src: The H-1B program allows U.S.
segments.tr: H-1B 프로그램은 미국

segments.src: employers to hire foreign workers in "specialty occupations" that typically require a bachelor's degree or higher, and it has long been a key hiring channel for technology companies, hospitals, universities and research labs.
segments.tr: 고용주가 일반적으로 학사 학위 이상을 요하는 "전문 직종"에 외국인 근로자를 채용할 수 있도록 허용하며, 오랫동안 기술 기업, 병원, 대학 및 연구소의 핵심 채용 경로 역할을 해왔습니다.

segments.src: A fee approaching six figures per petition would mark one of the most significant changes to the program's cost structure in its history.
segments.tr: 청원서당 6자리 수에 달하는 수수료는 이 프로그램의 역사상 가장 중대한 비용 구조의 변화 중 하나가 될 것입니다.

segments.src: ## What the Rule Actually Does
segments.tr: ## 이 규정이 실제 의미하는 바

segments.src: According to the filing, the proposed regulation would require many H-1B petitioners to pay $103,265 as part of the application process, a figure the administration has tied to broader efforts to prioritize higher-wage, higher-skill hiring and to discourage what it describes as the underpayment of visa holders relative to U.S.
segments.tr: 제출된 문서에 따르면, 제안된 규정은 많은 H-1B 청원인에게 신청 절차의 일환으로 $103,265를 납부하도록 요구할 것이며, 이는 행정부가 고임금·고숙련 채용을 우선시하고 유사한 역할을 하는 미국인

segments.src: workers in similar roles.
segments.tr: 근로자에 비해 비자 소지자에게 낮은 임금을 지급하는 행위를 억제하려는 광범위한 노력과 연계한 금액입니다.

segments.src: Supporters of the approach argue that a substantial fee could reduce the volume of lower-wage petitions and push employers toward hiring workers at wages closer to market rates.
segments.tr: 이 방식의 지지자들은 상당한 액수의 수수료가 저임금 청원 건수를 줄이고 고용주가 시장 임금에 가까운 수준으로 근로자를 채용하도록 유도할 수 있다고 주장합니다.

segments.src: Because the administration's earlier attempt to impose the fee through executive action was halted in court, the new filing follows the formal notice-and-comment rulemaking process.
segments.tr: 행정명령을 통해 수수료를 부과하려 했던 행정부의 이전 시도가 법원에서 중단되었기 때문에, 이번 새로운 입안은 공식적인 입법예고 및 의견 수렴 규정 제정 절차를 따릅니다.

segments.src: That means the public, including affected companies and workers, now has a window to submit feedback before the Department of Homeland Security or related agencies can move toward a final rule.
segments.tr: 이는 영향받는 기업과 근로자를 포함한 대중이 이제 국토안보부나 관련 기관이 최종 규정으로 진전시키기 전에 의견을 제출할 수 있는 기간을 갖게 되었음을 의미합니다.

segments.src: Comments filed during this period can influence the final wording, exemptions or implementation timeline, and the rule could still face legal challenges after it is finalized.
segments.tr: 이 기간 동안 제출된 의견은 최종 조항, 면제 대상 또는 시행 일정에 영향을 미칠 수 있으며, 규정이 최종 확정된 후에도 여전히 법적 이의 제기에 직면할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Who Could Feel It Most
segments.tr: ## 누가 가장 큰 영향을 받는가

segments.src: Industries that rely heavily on the H-1B program are watching closely.
segments.tr: H-1B 프로그램에 크게 의존하는 산업군들은 상황을 예의주시하고 있습니다.

segments.src: Technology firms have used the visa category for years to fill roles in software engineering, data science and other specialized fields.
segments.tr: 기술 기업들은 소프트웨어 엔지니어링, 데이터 과학 및 기타 전문 분야의 직무를 채우기 위해 수년간 이 비자 범주를 활용해 왔습니다.

segments.src: Hospitals and health systems, particularly in areas facing physician and specialist shortages, have used H-1B sponsorship to recruit doctors and researchers.
segments.tr: 특히 의사와 전문의 부족에 직면한 지역의 병원과 보건 시스템은 의사와 연구원을 영입하기 위해 H-1B 스폰서십을 이용해 왔습니다.

segments.src: Universities and research institutions similarly depend on the visa to bring in scientists, postdoctoral researchers and academic specialists from abroad.
segments.tr: 대학과 연구 기관 역시 해외에서 과학자, 박사후 연구원 및 학술 전문가를 초빙하기 위해 마찬가지로 이 비자에 의존하고 있습니다.

segments.src: A fee in the six-figure range would represent a major new cost for smaller employers and startups in particular, which typically have thinner margins than large multinational corporations.
segments.tr: 6자리 수 범위의 수수료는 특히 대기업 다국적 기업보다 이윤 폭이 좁은 소규모 고용주와 스타트업에 막대한 새로운 비용 부담이 될 것입니다.

segments.src: Larger companies with bigger hiring budgets may be better positioned to absorb the cost, potentially widening the gap between which employers can realistically sponsor international talent.
segments.tr: 채용 예산이 더 큰 대기업은 비용을 흡수하기에 더 유리한 위치에 있을 수 있으며, 이는 어떤 고용주가 현실적으로 해외 인재를 후원할 수 있는지에 대한 격차를 더 넓힐 가능성이 있습니다.

segments.src: ## The Debate Ahead
segments.tr: ## 앞에 놓인 논쟁

segments.src: Business groups and immigration attorneys have signaled they are likely to submit comments during the 30-day window, and some have suggested the size of the fee could still be challenged in court even after the rule is finalized, given the earlier judicial setback.
segments.tr: 기업 단체와 이민 변호사들은 30일의 기간 동안 의견을 제출할 가능성이 높다고 밝혔으며, 일부는 이전의 법원 판결 좌절을 감안할 때 규정이 확정된 후에도 수수료 액수에 대해 법원에서 다시 이의를 제기할 수 있다고 시사했습니다.

segments.src: Advocates for stricter immigration controls have generally welcomed higher costs as a way to ensure the program is used for genuinely specialized, high-wage roles rather than as a lower-cost alternative to domestic hiring.
segments.tr: 더 엄격한 이민 통제를 주창하는 이들은 일반적으로 높은 비용을 이 프로그램이 국내 채용의 저비용 대안이 아니라 진정한 전문 고임금 직무에 사용되도록 하는 방법으로 환영해 왔습니다.

segments.src: Critics, including some employer associations and worker advocacy groups, have raised concerns that a flat fee of this size does not account for differences between industries, company sizes or regions, and that it could disproportionately affect nonprofit research institutions, hospitals and smaller tech firms that do not have the same resources as major corporations.
segments.tr: 일부 고용주 협회와 근로자 옹호 단체를 포함한 비판자들은 이러한 규모의 일률적인 수수료가 산업, 기업 규모 또는 지역 간의 차이를 고려하지 않으며, 주요 대기업과 동일한 자원을 갖추지 못한 비영리 연구 기관, 병원 및 소규모 기술 기업에 불균형적인 영향을 미칠 수 있다는 우려를 제기했습니다.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## 향후 전망

segments.src: With the comment period now open, the coming weeks are expected to bring a wave of formal submissions from employers, universities, unions and legal experts.
segments.tr: 의견 수렴 기간이 시작됨에 따라 향후 수 주 동안 고용주, 대학, 노조 및 법률 전문가들로부터 대대적인 공식 의견 제출이 이어질 것으로 예상됩니다.

segments.src: The administration will be required to review and respond to substantive comments before issuing a final rule, a process that can take additional weeks or months depending on the volume and complexity of feedback received.
segments.tr: 행정부는 최종 규정을 발표하기 전에 실질적인 의견들을 검토하고 이에 응답해야 하며, 이 절차는 접수된 의견의 양과 복잡성에 따라 수 주 또는 수개월이 더 걸릴 수 있습니다.

segments.src: For now, employers planning to sponsor H-1B workers are being advised by immigration attorneys to monitor the rulemaking process closely, since the outcome could affect hiring budgets, timelines and strategy well into the next visa cycle.
segments.tr: 현재로서는 H-1B 근로자 후원을 계획 중인 고용주들이 규정 제정 절차를 면밀히 모니터링하도록 이민 변호사들로부터 조언받고 있으며, 그 결과가 다음 비자 주기까지 채용 예산, 일정 및 전략에 영향을 미칠 수 있기 때문입니다.

segments.src: Whether the $103,265 figure survives the comment period intact, or is adjusted before finalization, is likely to become clearer only after the public comment window closes and regulators issue their response.
segments.tr: $103,265라는 금액이 의견 수렴 기간 동안 온전히 유지될지, 아니면 최종 확정 전에 조정될지는 공개 의견 수렴 창구가 닫히고 규제 당국이 답변을 내놓은 후에야 명확해질 것으로 보입니다.

segments.src: Hospitals and health systems, particularly in areas facing physician and specialist shortages, have used H-1B sponsorship to recruit doctors and researchers.

segments.tr: ## 接下来的步骤

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: 随着意见征询期的开启，预计未来几周将迎来雇主、大学、工会和法律专家的大量正式意见提交。

segments.src: With the comment period now open, the coming weeks are expected to bring a wave of formal submissions from employers, universities, unions and legal experts.
segments.tr: 政府将被要求在发布最终规则之前审查并回应实质性意见，根据收到反馈的数量和复杂程度，这一过程可能需要额外的几周或几个月。

segments.src: The administration will be required to review and respond to substantive comments before issuing a final rule, a process that can take additional weeks or months depending on the volume and complexity of feedback received.
segments.tr: 目前，移民律师建议计划担保 H-1B 员工的雇主密切关注规则制定过程，因为其结果可能会影响到下一个签证周期的招聘预算、时间表和战略。

segments.src: After a federal judge blocked the Trump administration's attempt to impose a $103,265 fee on new H-1B applications, officials responded this week by publishing a formal rule aimed at putting the same price tag into law through the standard regulatory process.
segments.tr: एक संघीय न्यायाधीश द्वारा ट्रम्प प्रशासन के नई H-1B याचिकाओं पर $103,265 का शुल्क लगाने के प्रयास को रोकने के बाद, अधिकारियों ने इस सप्ताह मानक नियामक प्रक्रिया के माध्यम से उसी मूल्य टैग को कानून में बदलने के उद्देश्य से एक औपचारिक नियम प्रकाशित करके प्रतिक्रिया दी है।

segments.src: The move opens a 30-day public comment period, giving businesses, workers, universities and advocacy groups a chance to weigh in before the rule can be finalized.

segments.src: A fee approaching six figures per petition would mark one of the most significant changes to the program's cost structure in its history.

segments.src: According to the filing, the proposed regulation would require many H-1B petitioners to pay $103,265 as part of the application process, a figure the administration has tied to broader efforts to prioritize higher-wage, higher-skill hiring and to discourage what it describes as the underpayment of visa holders relative to U.S.
segments.tr: फाइलिंग के अनुसार, प्रस्तावित विनियमन के लिए कई H-1B याचिकाकर्ताओं को आवेदन प्रक्रिया के हिस्से के रूप में $103,265 का भुगतान करने की आवश्यकता होगी, एक ऐसा आंकड़ा जिसे प्रशासन ने उच्च-वेतन, उच्च-कौशल वाली भर्ती को प्राथमिकता देने और अमेरिकी की तुलना में वीज़ा धारकों को कम भुगतान करने के रूप में वर्णित किए जाने को हतोत्साहित करने के व्यापक प्रयासों से जोड़ा है।

segments.src: workers in similar roles.

segments.src: Supporters of the approach argue that a substantial fee could reduce the volume of lower-wage petitions and push employers toward hiring workers at wages closer to market rates.
segments.tr: इस दृष्टिकोण के समर्थकों का तर्क है कि एक बड़ा शुल्क कम वेतन वाली याचिकाओं की मात्रा को कम कर सकता है और नियोक्ताओं को बाजार दरों के करीब वेतन पर श्रमिकों को नियुक्त करने के लिए प्रेरित कर सकता है।

segments.src: Because the administration's earlier attempt to impose the fee through executive action was halted in court, the new filing follows the formal notice-and-comment rulemaking process.
segments.tr: चूंकि कार्यकारी कार्रवाई के माध्यम से शुल्क लगाने के प्रशासन के पहले के प्रयास को अदालत में रोक दिया गया था, इसलिए नई फाइलिंग औपचारिक नोटिस-और-टिप्पणी नियम बनाने की प्रक्रिया का पालन करती है।

segments.src: That means the public, including affected companies and workers, now has a window to submit feedback before the Department of Homeland Security or related agencies can move toward a final rule.
segments.tr: इसका मतलब है कि जनता, जिसमें प्रभावित कंपनियां और श्रमिक शामिल हैं, के पास अब होमलैंड सुरक्षा विभाग या संबंधित एजेंसियों के अंतिम नियम की ओर बढ़ने से पहले प्रतिक्रिया प्रस्तुत करने का एक अवसर है।

segments.src: Comments filed during this period can influence the final wording, exemptions or implementation timeline, and the rule could still face legal challenges after it is finalized.
segments.tr: इस अवधि के दौरान दायर की गई टिप्पणियां अंतिम शब्दांकन, छूट या कार्यान्वयन समयरेखा को प्रभावित कर सकती हैं, और नियम को अंतिम रूप दिए जाने के बाद भी इसे कानूनी चुनौतियों का सामना करना पड़ सकता है।

segments.src: ## Who Could Feel It Most
segments.tr: ## कौन इसे सबसे अधिक महसूस कर सकता है

segments.src: Industries that rely heavily on the H-1B program are watching closely.
segments.tr: H-1B कार्यक्रम पर भारी निर्भर रहने वाले उद्योग बारीकी से देख रहे हैं।

segments.src: Technology firms have used the visa category for years to fill roles in software engineering, data science and other specialized fields.
segments.tr: प्रौद्योगिकी फर्मों ने सॉफ्टवेयर इंजीनियरिंग, डेटा विज्ञान और अन्य विशेष क्षेत्रों में भूमिकाओं को भरने के लिए वर्षों से इस वीज़ा श्रेणी का उपयोग किया है।

segments.src: Hospitals and health systems, particularly in areas facing physician and specialist shortages, have used H-1B sponsorship to recruit doctors and researchers.
segments.tr: अस्पतालों और स्वास्थ्य प्रणालियों ने, विशेष रूप से चिकित्सक और विशेषज्ञ की कमी का सामना कर रहे क्षेत्रों में, डॉक्टरों और शोधकर्ताओं की भर्ती के लिए H-1B प्रायोजन का उपयोग किया है।

segments.src: Universities and research institutions similarly depend on the visa to bring in scientists, postdoctoral researchers and academic specialists from abroad.
segments.tr: विश्वविद्यालय और अनुसंधान संस्थान भी विदेश से वैज्ञानिकों, पोस्टडॉक्टरल शोधकर्ताओं और शैक्षणिक विशेषज्ञों को लाने के लिए इसी तरह वीज़ा पर निर्भर हैं।

segments.src: A fee in the six-figure range would represent a major new cost for smaller employers and startups in particular, which typically have thinner margins than large multinational corporations.
segments.tr: छह अंकों की सीमा में शुल्क विशेष रूप से छोटे नियोक्ताओं और स्टार्टअप्स के लिए एक बड़ी नई लागत का प्रतिनिधित्व करेगा, जिनके पास आमतौर पर बड़े बहुराष्ट्रीय निगमों की तुलना में कम मार्जिन होता है।

segments.src: Larger companies with bigger hiring budgets may be better positioned to absorb the cost, potentially widening the gap between which employers can realistically sponsor international talent.
segments.tr: बड़ी भर्ती बजट वाली बड़ी कंपनियां लागत को अवशोषित करने के लिए बेहतर स्थिति में हो सकती हैं, जिससे संभावित रूप से उन नियोक्ताओं के बीच अंतर बढ़ सकता है जो वास्तव में अंतरराष्ट्रीय प्रतिभा को प्रायोजित कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: ## The Debate Ahead
segments.tr: ## आगे की बहस

segments.src: Business groups and immigration attorneys have signaled they are likely to submit comments during the 30-day window, and some have suggested the size of the fee could still be challenged in court even after the rule is finalized, given the earlier judicial setback.
segments.tr: व्यावसायिक समूहों और आव्रजन वकीलों ने संकेत दिया है कि वे 30-दिन की अवधि के दौरान टिप्पणियां प्रस्तुत करने की संभावना रखते हैं, और कुछ ने सुझाव दिया है कि नियम को अंतिम रूप दिए जाने के बाद भी अदालत में शुल्क के आकार को चुनौती दी जा सकती है, पिछले न्यायिक झटके को देखते हुए।

segments.src: Advocates for stricter immigration controls have generally welcomed higher costs as a way to ensure the program is used for genuinely specialized, high-wage roles rather than as a lower-cost alternative to domestic hiring.
segments.tr: सख्त आव्रजन नियंत्रण के समर्थकों ने आम तौर पर उच्च लागत का स्वागत किया है ताकि यह सुनिश्चित किया जा सके कि कार्यक्रम का उपयोग घरेलू भर्ती के लिए कम लागत वाले विकल्प के बजाय वास्तव में विशेष, उच्च-वेतन वाली भूमिकाओं के लिए किया जाए।

segments.src: Critics, including some employer associations and worker advocacy groups, have raised concerns that a flat fee of this size does not account for differences between industries, company sizes or regions, and that it could disproportionately affect nonprofit research institutions, hospitals and smaller tech firms that do not have the same resources as major corporations.
segments.tr: आलोचकों, जिनमें कुछ नियोक्ता संघ और श्रमिक वकालत समूह शामिल हैं, ने चिंता जताई है कि इस आकार का एक फ्लैट शुल्क उद्योगों, कंपनी के आकार या क्षेत्रों के बीच के अंतर को ध्यान में नहीं रखता है, और यह गैर-लाभकारी अनुसंधान संस्थानों, अस्पतालों और छोटी तकनीकी फर्मों को असमान रूप से प्रभावित कर सकता है जिनके पास बड़े निगमों जैसे संसाधन नहीं हैं।

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## आगे क्या होता है

segments.src: With the comment period now open, the coming weeks are expected to bring a wave of formal submissions from employers, universities, unions and legal experts.
segments.tr: टिप्पणी अवधि अब खुली होने के साथ, आने वाले हफ्तों में नियोक्ताओं, विश्वविद्यालयों, यूनियनों और कानूनी विशेषज्ञों से औपचारिक प्रस्तुतियों की लहर आने की उम्मीद है।

segments.src: The administration will be required to review and respond to substantive comments before issuing a final rule, a process that can take additional weeks or months depending on the volume and complexity of feedback received.
segments.tr: प्रशासन को अंतिम नियम जारी करने से पहले ठोस टिप्पणियों की समीक्षा करने और उनका जवाब देने की आवश्यकता होगी, एक ऐसी प्रक्रिया जिसमें प्राप्त प्रतिक्रिया की मात्रा और जटिलता के आधार पर अतिरिक्त सप्ताह या महीने लग सकते हैं।

segments.src: For now, employers planning to sponsor H-1B workers are being advised by immigration attorneys to monitor the rulemaking process closely, since the outcome could affect hiring budgets, timelines and strategy well into the next visa cycle.
segments.tr: फिलहाल, H-1B श्रमिकों को प्रायोजित करने की योजना बना रहे नियोक्ताओं को आव्रजन वकीलों द्वारा नियम बनाने की प्रक्रिया पर बारीकी से नज़र रखने की सलाह दी जा रही है, क्योंकि परिणाम अगले वीज़ा चक्र तक भर्ती बजट, समयरेखा और रणनीति को प्रभावित कर सकता है।

segments.src: Whether the $103,265 figure survives the comment period intact, or is adjusted before finalization, is likely to become clearer only after the public comment window closes and regulators issue their response.
segments.tr: क्या $103,265 का आंकड़ा टिप्पणी अवधि के बाद भी बरकरार रहता है, या अंतिम रूप देने से पहले समायोजित किया जाता है, यह केवल सार्वजनिक टिप्पणी विंडो बंद होने और नियामकों द्वारा अपनी प्रतिक्रिया जारी करने के बाद ही स्पष्ट होने की संभावना है।

pt.title: O Preço de $103.265: Por Dentro da Iniciativa de Trump para Tornar Permanente a Taxa do Visto H-1B

segments.src: ## A Fee That Refuses to Go Away
segments.tr: ## Uma Taxa que se Recusa a Desaparecer

segments.src: A six-figure charge on H-1B visa petitions is back in the spotlight.
segments.tr: Uma cobrança de seis dígitos em petições de visto H-1B está de volta aos holofotes.

segments.src: After a federal judge blocked the Trump administration's attempt to impose a $103,265 fee on new H-1B applications, officials responded this week by publishing a formal rule aimed at putting the same price tag into law through the standard regulatory process.
segments.tr: Depois que um juiz federal bloqueou a tentativa da administração Trump de impor uma taxa de $103.265 em novas solicitações de H-1B, as autoridades responderam esta semana publicando uma regra formal destinada a colocar o mesmo preço em lei por meio do processo regulatório padrão.

segments.src: The move opens a 30-day public comment period, giving businesses, workers, universities and advocacy groups a chance to weigh in before the rule can be finalized.
segments.tr: A medida abre um período de consulta pública de 30 dias, dando a empresas, trabalhadores, universidades e grupos de defesa a chance de se manifestarem antes que a regra possa ser finalizada.

segments.src: The H-1B program allows U.S.
segments.tr: O programa H-1B permite que empregadores dos EUA

segments.src: employers to hire foreign workers in "specialty occupations" that typically require a bachelor's degree or higher, and it has long been a key hiring channel for technology companies, hospitals, universities and research labs.
segments.tr: contratem trabalhadores estrangeiros em "ocupações especializadas" que normalmente exigem bacharelado ou superior, e há muito tempo tem sido um canal de contratação fundamental para empresas de tecnologia, hospitais, universidades e laboratórios de pesquisa.

segments.src: A fee approaching six figures per petition would mark one of the most significant changes to the program's cost structure in its history.
segments.tr: Uma taxa que se aproxima de seis dígitos por petição marcaria uma das mudanças mais significativas na estrutura de custos do programa em sua história.

segments.src: ## What the Rule Actually Does
segments.tr: ## O que a Regra Realmente Faz

segments.src: According to the filing, the proposed regulation would require many H-1B petitioners to pay $103,265 as part of the application process, a figure the administration has tied to broader efforts to prioritize higher-wage, higher-skill hiring and to discourage what it describes as the underpayment of visa holders relative to U.S.
segments.tr: De acordo com o documento, a regulamentação proposta exigiria que muitos solicitantes de H-1B pagassem $103.265 como parte do processo de inscrição, um valor que a administração vinculou a esforços mais amplos para priorizar contratações de salários mais altos e maior qualificação, e para desestimular o que descreve como o subpagamento de titulares de vistos em relação aos trabalhadores dos EUA

segments.src: workers in similar roles.
segments.tr: em funções semelhantes.

segments.src: Supporters of the approach argue that a substantial fee could reduce the volume of lower-wage petitions and push employers toward hiring workers at wages closer to market rates.
segments.tr: Os defensores da abordagem argumentam que uma taxa substancial poderia reduzir o volume de petições de salários mais baixos e empurrar os empregadores para a contratação de trabalhadores com salários mais próximos das taxas de mercado.

segments.src: Because the administration's earlier attempt to impose the fee through executive action was halted in court, the new filing follows the formal notice-and-comment rulemaking process.
segments.tr: Como a tentativa anterior da administração de impor a taxa por meio de ação executiva foi interrompida nos tribunais, o novo documento segue o processo formal de elaboração de regras com aviso prévio e comentários.

segments.src: That means the public, including affected companies and workers, now has a window to submit feedback before the Department of Homeland Security or related agencies can move toward a final rule.
segments.tr: Isso significa que o público, incluindo empresas e trabalhadores afetados, agora tem um prazo para enviar feedback antes que o Departamento de Segurança Interna ou agências relacionadas possam avançar em direção a uma regra final.

segments.src: Comments filed during this period can influence the final wording, exemptions or implementation timeline, and the rule could still face legal challenges after it is finalized.
segments.tr: Os comentários apresentados durante este período podem influenciar a redação final, as isenções ou o cronograma de implementação, e a regra ainda poderá enfrentar contestações legais após ser finalizada.

segments.src: ## Who Could Feel It Most
segments.tr: ## Quem Poderia Sentir Isso Mais

segments.src: Industries that rely heavily on the H-1B program are watching closely.
segments.tr: As indústrias que dependem fortemente do programa H-1B estão acompanhando de perto.

segments.src: Technology firms have used the visa category for years to fill roles in software engineering, data science and other specialized fields.
segments.tr: As empresas de tecnologia têm usado a categoria de visto há anos para preencher cargos em engenharia de software, ciência de dados e outros campos especializados.

segments.src: Hospitals and health systems, particularly in areas facing physician and specialist shortages, have used H-1B sponsorship to recruit doctors and researchers.
segments.tr: Hospitais e sistemas de saúde, particularmente em áreas que enfrentam escassez de médicos e especialistas, usaram o patrocínio de H-1B para recrutar médicos e pesquisadores.

segments.src: Universities and research institutions similarly depend on the visa to bring in scientists, postdoctoral researchers and academic specialists from abroad.
segments.tr: Universidades e instituições de pesquisa dependem de forma semelhante do visto para trazer cientistas, pesquisadores de pós-doutorado e especialistas acadêmicos do exterior.

segments.src: A fee in the six-figure range would represent a major new cost for smaller employers and startups in particular, which typically have thinner margins than large multinational corporations.
segments.tr: Uma taxa na faixa de seis dígitos representaria um novo custo importante para empregadores menores e startups em particular, que normalmente têm margens mais apertadas do que grandes corporações multinacionais.

segments.src: Larger companies with bigger hiring budgets may be better positioned to absorb the cost, potentially widening the gap between which employers can realistically sponsor international talent.
segments.tr: Empresas maiores com maiores orçamentos de contratação podem estar mais bem posicionadas para absorver o custo, potencialmente ampliando a lacuna entre quais empregadores podem realisticamente patrocinar talentos internacionais.

segments.src: ## The Debate Ahead
segments.tr: ## O Debate Futuro

segments.src: Business groups and immigration attorneys have signaled they are likely to submit comments during the 30-day window, and some have suggested the size of the fee could still be challenged in court even after the rule is finalized, given the earlier judicial setback.
segments.tr: Grupos empresariais e advogados de imigração sinalizaram que provavelmente enviarão comentários durante a janela de 30 dias, e alguns sugeriram que o tamanho da taxa ainda poderia ser contestado nos tribunais mesmo após a regra ser finalizada, dado o revés judicial anterior.

segments.src: Advocates for stricter immigration controls have generally welcomed higher costs as a way to ensure the program is used for genuinely specialized, high-wage roles rather than as a lower-cost alternative to domestic hiring.
segments.tr: Os defensores de controles de imigração mais rígidos geralmente receberam bem os custos mais altos como uma forma de garantir que o programa seja usado para funções genuinamente especializadas e de altos salários, em vez de como uma alternativa de menor custo à contratação doméstica.

segments.src: Critics, including some employer associations and worker advocacy groups, have raised concerns that a flat fee of this size does not account for differences between industries, company sizes or regions, and that it could disproportionately affect nonprofit research institutions, hospitals and smaller tech firms that do not have the same resources as major corporations.
segments.tr: Críticos, incluindo algumas associações de empregadores e grupos de defesa dos trabalhadores, levantaram preocupações de que uma taxa fixa desse porte não leve em conta as diferenças entre indústrias, tamanhos de empresas ou regiões, e que possa afetar desproporcionalmente instituições de pesquisa sem fins lucrativos, hospitais e empresas de tecnologia menores que não têm os mesmos recursos que as grandes corporações.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## O que Acontece a Seguir

segments.src: With the comment period now open, the coming weeks are expected to bring a wave of formal submissions from employers, universities, unions and legal experts.
segments.tr: Com o período de comentários agora aberto, espera-se que as próximas semanas tragam uma onda de submissões formais de empregadores, universidades, sindicatos e especialistas jurídicos.

segments.src: The administration will be required to review and respond to substantive comments before issuing a final rule, a process that can take additional weeks or months depending on the volume and complexity of feedback received.
segments.tr: A administração será obrigada a analisar e responder aos comentários substantivos antes de emitir uma regra final, um processo que pode levar semanas ou meses adicionais, dependendo do volume e da complexidade do feedback recebido.

segments.src: For now, employers planning to sponsor H-1B workers are being advised by immigration attorneys to monitor the rulemaking process closely, since the outcome could affect hiring budgets, timelines and strategy well into the next visa cycle.
segments.tr: Por enquanto, os empregadores que planejam patrocinar trabalhadores com visto H-1B estão sendo aconselhados por advogados de imigração a monitorar de perto o processo de elaboração de regras, uma vez que o resultado pode afetar os orçamentos de contratação, cronogramas e estratégia até o próximo ciclo de vistos.

segments.src: Whether the $103,265 figure survives the comment period intact, or is adjusted before finalization, is likely to become clearer only after the public comment window closes and regulators issue their response.
segments.tr: Se o valor de $103.265 sobreviverá intacto ao período de comentários ou será ajustado antes da finalização, provavelmente só ficará mais claro após o fechamento da janela de consulta pública e a emissão de resposta pelos reguladores.

segments.src: ## Who Could Feel It Most

segments.src: Hospitals and health systems, particularly in areas facing physician and specialist shortages, have used H-1B sponsorship to recruit doctors and researchers.

segments.src: Universities and research institutions similarly depend on the visa to bring in scientists, postdoctoral researchers and academic specialists from abroad.
segments.tr: 大学や研究機関も同様に、海外から科学者、ポスドク研究員、学術専門家を受け入れるためにこのビザに依存しています。

segments.src: A fee in the six-figure range would represent a major new cost for smaller employers and startups in particular, which typically have thinner margins than large multinational corporations.

segments.src: ## The Debate Ahead

segments.src: ## What Happens Next

segments.src: For now, employers planning to sponsor H-1B workers are being advised by immigration attorneys to monitor the rulemaking process closely, since the outcome could affect hiring budgets, timelines and strategy well into the next visa cycle.

de.title: Das 103.265-Dollar-Preisschild: Hinter Trumps Vorstoß, seine H-1B-Visumgebühr dauerhaft zu machen

segments.src: ## A Fee That Refuses to Go Away
segments.tr: ## Eine Gebühr, die nicht verschwinden will

segments.src: A six-figure charge on H-1B visa petitions is back in the spotlight.
segments.tr: Eine sechsstellige Gebühr für H-1B-Visumanträge steht wieder im Rampenlicht.

segments.src: After a federal judge blocked the Trump administration's attempt to impose a $103,265 fee on new H-1B applications, officials responded this week by publishing a formal rule aimed at putting the same price tag into law through the standard regulatory process.
segments.tr: Nachdem ein Bundesrichter den Versuch der Trump-Regierung gestoppt hatte, eine Gebühr von 103.265 US-Dollar für neue H-1B-Anträge zu erheben, reagierten Beamte diese Woche mit der Veröffentlichung einer formalen Regel, die darauf abzielt, denselben Preis über den standardmäßigen regulatorischen Prozess gesetzlich festzuschreiben.

segments.src: The move opens a 30-day public comment period, giving businesses, workers, universities and advocacy groups a chance to weigh in before the rule can be finalized.
segments.tr: Dieser Schritt eröffnet eine 30-tägige öffentliche Konsultationsphase, die Unternehmen, Arbeitnehmern, Universitäten und Interessenverbänden die Möglichkeit gibt, sich zu äußern, bevor die Regel finalisiert werden kann.

segments.src: The H-1B program allows U.S.
segments.tr: Das H-1B-Programm ermöglicht es US-amerikanischen

segments.src: employers to hire foreign workers in "specialty occupations" that typically require a bachelor's degree or higher, and it has long been a key hiring channel for technology companies, hospitals, universities and research labs.
segments.tr: Arbeitgebern, ausländische Arbeitskräfte in „Spezialberufen“ einzustellen, die typischerweise einen Bachelor-Abschluss oder höher erfordern, und es ist seit langem ein wichtiger Rekrutierungskanal für Technologieunternehmen, Krankenhäuser, Universitäten und Forschungslabore.

segments.src: A fee approaching six figures per petition would mark one of the most significant changes to the program's cost structure in its history.
segments.tr: Eine Gebühr, die sich pro Antrag der Marke von sechs Stellen nähert, würde eine der bedeutendsten Änderungen der Kostenstruktur des Programms in seiner Geschichte darstellen.

segments.src: ## What the Rule Actually Does
segments.tr: ## Was die Regel tatsächlich bewirkt

segments.src: According to the filing, the proposed regulation would require many H-1B petitioners to pay $103,265 as part of the application process, a figure the administration has tied to broader efforts to prioritize higher-wage, higher-skill hiring and to discourage what it describes as the underpayment of visa holders relative to U.S.
segments.tr: Dem Antrag zufolge würde die vorgeschriebene Verordnung viele H-1B-Antragsteller dazu verpflichten, 103.265 US-Dollar als Teil des Antragsverfahrens zu zahlen – eine Summe, die die Regierung mit umfassenderen Bemühungen verknüpft hat, die Einstellung von Arbeitskräften mit höheren Löhnen und Qualifikationen zu priorisieren und dem entgegenzuwirken, was sie als Unterbezahlung von Visuminhabern im Vergleich zu US-amerikanischen

segments.src: workers in similar roles.
segments.tr: Arbeitnehmern in ähnlichen Rollen bezeichnet.

segments.src: Supporters of the approach argue that a substantial fee could reduce the volume of lower-wage petitions and push employers toward hiring workers at wages closer to market rates.
segments.tr: Befürworter dieses Ansatzes argumentieren, dass eine beträchtliche Gebühr das Volumen an Anträgen für niedrigere Löhne verringern und Arbeitgeber dazu drängen könnte, Arbeitskräfte zu Löhnen einzustellen, die näher am Marktwiveau liegen.

segments.src: Because the administration's earlier attempt to impose the fee through executive action was halted in court, the new filing follows the formal notice-and-comment rulemaking process.
segments.tr: Da der frühere Versuch der Regierung, die Gebühr durch Exekutivmaßnahmen einzuführen, vor Gericht gestoppt wurde, folgt der neue Antrag dem formalen Regelsetzungsverfahren mit öffentlicher Anhörung (Notice-and-Comment).

segments.src: That means the public, including affected companies and workers, now has a window to submit feedback before the Department of Homeland Security or related agencies can move toward a final rule.
segments.tr: Das bedeutet, dass die Öffentlichkeit, einschließlich betroffener Unternehmen und Arbeitnehmer, nun Zeitfenster hat, um Feedback einzureichen, bevor das Heimatschutzministerium (Department of Homeland Security) oder verwandte Behörden auf eine endgültige Regel hinarbeiten können.

segments.src: Comments filed during this period can influence the final wording, exemptions or implementation timeline, and the rule could still face legal challenges after it is finalized.
segments.tr: Kommentare, die in diesem Zeitraum eingereicht werden, können den finalen Wortlaut, Ausnahmen oder den Zeitplan für die Umsetzung beeinflussen, und die Regel könnte nach ihrer Finalisierung immer noch vor Gericht angefochten werden.

segments.src: ## Who Could Feel It Most
segments.tr: ## Wer es am meisten spüren könnte

segments.src: Industries that rely heavily on the H-1B program are watching closely.
segments.tr: Branchen, die stark vom H-1B-Programm abhängig sind, beobachten die Entwicklungen genau.

segments.src: Technology firms have used the visa category for years to fill roles in software engineering, data science and other specialized fields.
segments.tr: Technologieunternehmen nutzen die Visumskategorie seit Jahren, um Rollen in der Softwareentwicklung, Datenwissenschaft und anderen spezialisierten Bereichen zu besetzen.

segments.src: Hospitals and health systems, particularly in areas facing physician and specialist shortages, have used H-1B sponsorship to recruit doctors and researchers.
segments.tr: Krankenhäuser und Gesundheitssysteme, insbesondere in Regionen mit Mangel an Ärzten und Spezialisten, haben die H-1B-Sponsorenschaft genutzt, um Ärzte und Forscher zu rekrutieren.

segments.src: Universities and research institutions similarly depend on the visa to bring in scientists, postdoctoral researchers and academic specialists from abroad.
segments.tr: Universitäten und Forschungseinrichtungen sind gleichermaßen auf das Visum angewiesen, um Wissenschaftler, Postdoktoranden und akademische Spezialisten aus dem Ausland zu holen.

segments.src: A fee in the six-figure range would represent a major new cost for smaller employers and startups in particular, which typically have thinner margins than large multinational corporations.
segments.tr: Eine Gebühr im sechsstelligen Bereich würde insbesondere für kleinere Arbeitgeber und Start-ups eine enorme neue Belastung darstellen, da diese in der Regel geringere Gewinnspannen als große multinationalen Konzerne aufweisen.

segments.src: Larger companies with bigger hiring budgets may be better positioned to absorb the cost, potentially widening the gap between which employers can realistically sponsor international talent.
segments.tr: Größere Unternehmen mit größeren Einstellungsbudgets sind möglicherweise besser in der Lage, die Kosten zu tragen, was die Kluft zwischen den Arbeitgebern, die sich internationales Talent realistischerweise sponsern können, weiter vergrößern könnte.

segments.src: ## The Debate Ahead
segments.tr: ## Die bevorstehende Debatte

segments.src: Business groups and immigration attorneys have signaled they are likely to submit comments during the 30-day window, and some have suggested the size of the fee could still be challenged in court even after the rule is finalized, given the earlier judicial setback.
segments.tr: Wirtschaftsverbände und Einwanderungsanwälte haben signalisiert, dass sie während des 30-tägigen Fensters wahrscheinlich Kommentare einreichen werden, und einige haben angedeutet, dass die Höhe der Gebühr nach der Finalisierung der Regel immer noch vor Gericht angefochten werden könnte, angesichts des früheren richterlichen Rückschlags.

segments.src: Advocates for stricter immigration controls have generally welcomed higher costs as a way to ensure the program is used for genuinely specialized, high-wage roles rather than as a lower-cost alternative to domestic hiring.
segments.tr: Befürworter strengerer Einwanderungskontrollen haben höhere Kosten im Allgemeinen als Mittel begrüßt, um sicherzustellen, dass das Programm für wirklich spezialisierte, gut bezahlte Positionen genutzt wird, anstatt als billigere Alternative zur inländischen Personalbeschaffung zu dienen.

segments.src: Critics, including some employer associations and worker advocacy groups, have raised concerns that a flat fee of this size does not account for differences between industries, company sizes or regions, and that it could disproportionately affect nonprofit research institutions, hospitals and smaller tech firms that do not have the same resources as major corporations.
segments.tr: Kritiker, darunter einige Arbeitgeberverbände und Arbeitnehmer-Interessengruppen, haben Bedenken geäußert, dass eine Pauschalgebühr dieser Größenordnung Unterschiede zwischen Branchen, Unternehmensgrößen oder Regionen nicht berücksichtigt und dass sie gemeinnützige Forschungseinrichtungen, Krankenhäuser und kleinere Tech-Firmen unverhältnismäßig stark treffen könnte, die nicht über dieselben Ressourcen wie große Konzerne verfügen.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## Was als Nächstes geschieht

segments.src: With the comment period now open, the coming weeks are expected to bring a wave of formal submissions from employers, universities, unions and legal experts.
segments.tr: Da die Kommentierungsphase nun eröffnet ist, wird erwartet, dass die kommenden Wochen eine Welle formaler Eingaben von Arbeitgebern, Universitäten, Gewerkschaften und Rechtsexperten mit sich bringen werden.

segments.src: The administration will be required to review and respond to substantive comments before issuing a final rule, a process that can take additional weeks or months depending on the volume and complexity of feedback received.
segments.tr: Die Regierung wird verpflichtet sein, sachbezogene Kommentare zu prüfen und darauf zu reagieren, bevor sie eine endgültige Regel erlässt – ein Prozess, der je nach Umfang und Komplexität des erhaltenen Feedbacks zusätzliche Wochen oder Monate dauern kann.

segments.src: For now, employers planning to sponsor H-1B workers are being advised by immigration attorneys to monitor the rulemaking process closely, since the outcome could affect hiring budgets, timelines and strategy well into the next visa cycle.
segments.tr: Vorerst wird Arbeitgebern, die planen, H-1B-Arbeitnehmer zu sponsern, von Einwanderungsanwälten geraten, den Prozess der Regeldefinition genau zu überwachen, da das Ergebnis die Einstellungsbudgets, Zeitpläne und Strategien bis weit in den nächsten Visumzyklus hinein beeinflussen könnte.

segments.src: Whether the $103,265 figure survives the comment period intact, or is adjusted before finalization, is likely to become clearer only after the public comment window closes and regulators issue their response.
segments.tr: Ob die Summe von 103.265 US-Dollar die Kommentierungsphase unversehrt übersteht oder vor der Finalisierung angepasst wird, dürfte erst nach Ablauf des öffentlichen Konsultationsfensters und der Stellungnahme der Regulierungsbehörden klarer werden.

segments.tr: Các bệnh viện và hệ thống y tế, đặc biệt là ở các khu vực đang đối mặt với tình trạng thiếu bác sĩ và chuyên gia, đã sử dụng việc bảo lãnh H-1B để tuyển dụng bác sĩ và nhà nghiên cứu.

segments.src: Universities and research institutions similarly depend on the visa to bring in scientists, postdoctoral researchers and academic specialists from abroad.
segments.tr: Các trường đại học và tổ chức nghiên cứu tương tự cũng phụ thuộc vào thị thực để đưa các nhà khoa học, nhà nghiên cứu sau tiến sĩ và chuyên gia học thuật từ nước ngoài vào.

segments.src: A fee in the six-figure range would represent a major new cost for smaller employers and startups in particular, which typically have thinner margins than large multinational corporations.
segments.tr: Mức phí trong phạm vi sáu chữ số sẽ đại diện cho một chi phí mới lớn đối với các nhà tuyển dụng nhỏ và công ty khởi nghiệp nói riêng, những nơi thường có biên lợi nhuận mỏng hơn so với các tập đoàn đa quốc gia lớn.

segments.src: Larger companies with bigger hiring budgets may be better positioned to absorb the cost, potentially widening the gap between which employers can realistically sponsor international talent.
segments.tr: Các công ty lớn hơn với ngân sách tuyển dụng lớn hơn có thể có vị thế tốt hơn để hấp thụ chi phí, có khả năng làm rộng thêm khoảng cách về việc nhà tuyển dụng nào có thể thực tế bảo lãnh nhân talent quốc tế.

segments.src: ## The Debate Ahead
segments.tr: ## Cuộc tranh luận phía trước

segments.src: Business groups and immigration attorneys have signaled they are likely to submit comments during the 30-day window, and some have suggested the size of the fee could still be challenged in court even after the rule is finalized, given the earlier judicial setback.
segments.tr: Các nhóm doanh nghiệp và luật sư di trú đã ra hiệu rằng họ có khả năng sẽ gửi ý kiến trong thời gian 30 ngày, và một số đã gợi ý rằng quy mô của khoản phí vẫn có thể bị thách thức tại tòa án ngay cả sau khi quy tắc được hoàn tất, do sự thụt lùi về tư pháp trước đó.

segments.src: Advocates for stricter immigration controls have generally welcomed higher costs as a way to ensure the program is used for genuinely specialized, high-wage roles rather than as a lower-cost alternative to domestic hiring.
segments.tr: Những người ủng hộ việc kiểm soát di trú nghiêm ngặt hơn thường hoan nghênh chi phí cao hơn như một cách để đảm bảo chương trình được sử dụng cho các vai trò chuyên môn thực sự, lương cao thay vì là một giải pháp thay thế chi phí thấp hơn cho việc tuyển dụng trong nước.

segments.src: Critics, including some employer associations and worker advocacy groups, have raised concerns that a flat fee of this size does not account for differences between industries, company sizes or regions, and that it could disproportionately affect nonprofit research institutions, hospitals and smaller tech firms that do not have the same resources as major corporations.
segments.tr: Các nhà phê bình, bao gồm một số hiệp hội chủ lao động và nhóm vận động người lao động, đã nêu lên quan ngại rằng một khoản phí cố định có quy mô này không tính đến sự khác biệt giữa các ngành công nghiệp, quy mô công ty hoặc khu vực, và nó có thể ảnh hưởng bất cân xứng đến các tổ chức nghiên cứu phi lợi nhuận, bệnh viện và các công ty công nghệ nhỏ hơn không có cùng nguồn lực như các tập đoàn lớn.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## Điều gì xảy ra tiếp theo

segments.src: With the comment period now open, the coming weeks are expected to bring a wave of formal submissions from employers, universities, unions and legal experts.
segments.tr: Với giai đoạn góp ý hiện đang mở, các tuần tới dự kiến sẽ mang lại một làn sóng nộp hồ sơ chính thức từ các chủ lao động, trường đại học, công đoàn và chuyên gia pháp lý.

segments.src: The administration will be required to review and respond to substantive comments before issuing a final rule, a process that can take additional weeks or months depending on the volume and complexity of feedback received.
segments.tr: Chính quyền sẽ được yêu cầu xem xét và phản hồi các ý kiến thực chất trước khi ban hành quy tắc cuối cùng, một quá trình có thể mất thêm vài tuần hoặc vài tháng tùy thuộc vào khối lượng và độ phức tạp của phản hồi nhận được.

segments.src: For now, employers planning to sponsor H-1B workers are being advised by immigration attorneys to monitor the rulemaking process closely, since the outcome could affect hiring budgets, timelines and strategy well into the next visa cycle.
segments.tr: Hiện tại, các chủ lao động có kế hoạch bảo lãnh người lao động H-1B đang được các luật sư di trú khuyên theo dõi sát sao quá trình làm quy tắc, vì kết quả có thể ảnh hưởng đến ngân sách tuyển dụng, mốc thời gian và chiến lược sang chu kỳ thị thực tiếp theo.

segments.src: Whether the $103,265 figure survives the comment period intact, or is adjusted before finalization, is likely to become clearer only after the public comment window closes and regulators issue their response.
segments.tr: Liệu con số $103,265 có sống sót qua giai đoạn góp ý mà không bị tổn hại, hay được điều chỉnh trước khi hoàn tất, chỉ có khả năng trở nên rõ ràng hơn sau khi thời gian góp ý công khai đóng cửa và các cơ quan quản lý đưa ra phản hồi của họ.
